title: Getting Started
html:
This guide is also available as a 4 minute video walkthrough.

#1. Install ETS2LA

Download the installer for your platform from the download page, then run it and follow the prompts.

Platform File Requirements
Windows ETS2LA-win-*.msi Included
Linux ETS2LA-linux-*.AppImage GLIBC 2.43

ETS2LA is version specific, make sure you're on a game version listed in the latest release notes.

#2. Follow the ETS2LA onboarding

When you first launch ETS2LA, it will guide you through the onboarding process. This onboarding process contains everything you need to get started.

#3. Use Your Keybinds

Once you've got some plugins enabled, you can enable their features by using keybinds, by default these are the following:

Action Keybind
RES / Increase Up Arrow
SET / Decrease Down Arrow
MODE / Cancel Left Arrow
Next / Confirm Right Arrow

The TLDR is that you can use the RES and SET buttons to enable, and the MODE button to disable driving assistance.

#Troubleshooting

If something isn't working, the FAQ covers the most common issues. Still stuck? Ask in the #support channel on Discord.
